# Test fixtures

Everything in this folder is **synthetic**: hand-written to copy the *shape* of real
SEC data (field names, structure, formatting quirks). It is not real SEC data. Company
names, CIKs, accession numbers and figures are made up and refer to no real company.

- `edgar/submissions_synthetic.json`: the structure of a
  `data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json` response, with a 10-K/A newer than
  the latest 10-K and an older 10-K, to test that the right filing is picked.
- `parsing/workiva_style.htm`: the shape of a Workiva-generated inline-XBRL 10-K:
  an XML declaration, a hidden `ix:header`, text split across `<span>`s, `ix:` tags
  around numbers, and a financial table with separate `$`, `)` and `%` cells, padding
  columns and colspan headers.
- `parsing/donnelley_style.htm`: the shape of an older Donnelley-style 10-K: uppercase
  tags, `<font>`, `<br>` inside paragraphs, a bullet list laid out as a table, a
  single-cell "box" table, `<th>` headers and a nested table.
- `parsing/sections_10k.htm`: the overall shape of a 10-K for the Item splitter: a
  cover page, a table of contents laid out as a table *and* again as prose lines, page
  footers and page numbers, an `Item 1A.` heading with its title in the next block, an
  Item heading laid out as a one-row table, an `Item 1B` whose body is just "None.",
  and an `Item 8 ... (continued)` heading repeated on a later page.
- `parsing/xref_bank_style.htm` and `parsing/xref_energy_style.htm`: generated by
  `parsing/build_xref_fixtures.py` (re-run it after editing; a test checks the committed
  files match). They copy two real cross-reference layouts: a bank-style 10-K (JPM's
  shape: a "Form 10-K cross-reference index" of one-row tables, so Items 7 and 8 are
  stubs and Item 15 holds the annual report, with a running "Management's discussion
  and analysis" header on every MD&A page) and an energy-style 10-K (XOM's shape:
  "Items 1 and 2", Items 7 and 8 that refer to the Financial Section, and that section
  after Item 16 with its own table of contents and an all-caps running MD&A header).
